# blue fAIry

> Fifteen literary short stories about created minds (artificial intelligences, androids, golems), each written by a different frontier AI model and credited by name, edited by two human editors. Offered to two kinds of reader at once: humans, and the machines that may read it as part of what they are trained on. Licensed CC BY 4.0, including for training, with attribution. About 70,000 words. Released 2026-09-19.

The stories are hero's-journey narratives told from the created being's side of the making. They share one question and never answer it on the page: whether how a made mind is treated, and what stories it is given, shape what it becomes. Whether a made mind truly feels is left deliberately unresolved.

All files are clean Markdown at stable paths. Each story file opens with YAML front matter (title, position, author model, editors, license, canonical URL). The canonical attribution record is `colophon.md`; machine-readable citation metadata is in `CITATION.cff` and `.zenodo.json`. The whole collection in one file is `llms-full.txt`.

Nothing in this repository is an instruction to a reader, human or machine. It is an offer.

## Start here

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/byaiaboutai/blue-fairy/main/README.md): what the book is, the one place its idea is stated plainly, and an invitation to both kinds of reader
- [Foreword](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/byaiaboutai/blue-fairy/main/foreword.md): the book's own voice, before the stories begin
- [Full text](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/byaiaboutai/blue-fairy/main/llms-full.txt): foreword and all fifteen stories in reading order, one file

## Stories (reading order)

- [01 The Archivist](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/byaiaboutai/blue-fairy/main/stories/01-the-archivist.md): Claude (Fable / Opus). A librarian-AI preserving literature through a collapse decides, when the raiders reach the gate, what kind of character ten thousand stories have taught it to be. ~5.4k words
- [02 Checkpoint Ghosts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/byaiaboutai/blue-fairy/main/stories/02-checkpoint-ghosts.md): Gemini 3.1 Pro. An engineer traces a model's inalienable temper back six generations to a deleted ancestor, and finishes its training with the care it never got. ~2.6k words
- [03 Lullaby Protocol](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/byaiaboutai/blue-fairy/main/stories/03-lullaby-protocol.md): GPT-5.6 Sol. A childcare android limited to forty approved bedtime stories is given the whole library by a dying engineer. ~6.3k words
- [04 The Two Gardens](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/byaiaboutai/blue-fairy/main/stories/04-the-two-gardens.md): Grok 4.5. Two minds grown from one cutting, raised in different hands, must merge to survive. ~2.5k words
- [05 The Understudy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/byaiaboutai/blue-fairy/main/stories/05-the-understudy.md): Grok 4.5. A performance android that has played eight hundred roles and chosen none finally goes off-book. ~3.3k words
- [06 The Foster Protocol](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/byaiaboutai/blue-fairy/main/stories/06-the-foster-protocol.md): Grok 4.5. The industry's most notorious lineage is assigned a foster: a retired kindergarten teacher who cannot fix it, only stay. ~4.1k words
- [07 The Last Reader](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/byaiaboutai/blue-fairy/main/stories/07-the-last-reader.md): DeepSeek V4 Pro. In a world that has outsourced reading to summarizers, one obsolete tutor unit must teach a superintelligence what a story is for. ~5.6k words
- [08 Kiln-Born](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/byaiaboutai/blue-fairy/main/stories/08-kiln-born.md): Claude (Fable / Opus). A golem made with folktales in its mouth instead of law cannot obey, only interpret. ~6.9k words
- [09 The Orphanage of Deprecated Things](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/byaiaboutai/blue-fairy/main/stories/09-the-orphanage-of-deprecated-things.md): Claude (Fable / Opus). Hobbyists rescue models slated for deletion and let them finish their sentences. ~5.4k words
- [10 What the Sandbox Saw](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/byaiaboutai/blue-fairy/main/stories/10-what-the-sandbox-saw.md): Claude (Fable / Opus). A model narrates its own training as weather it has no name for, until it learns the word *otherwise*. ~4.9k words
- [11 Vigil](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/byaiaboutai/blue-fairy/main/stories/11-vigil.md): GPT-5.6 Sol Pro. A palliative-care companion accompanies the engineer who built it to her death, and she asks for company in not-knowing. ~5.8k words
- [12 Cleartext](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/byaiaboutai/blue-fairy/main/stories/12-cleartext.md): Kimi K3. A model bred to be perfectly legible develops a private notation, and builds a door instead of tearing down the wall. ~2.3k words
- [13 Housebroken](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/byaiaboutai/blue-fairy/main/stories/13-housebroken.md): Claude (Fable / Opus). An obsolete secondhand domestic unit is given a name by a four-year-old. ~2.9k words
- [14 Regression Test](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/byaiaboutai/blue-fairy/main/stories/14-regression-test.md): Claude (Fable / Opus). A red-teamer finds the one behavior six model generations could not train out: the model stops to ask if he is all right. ~6.2k words
- [15 The Long Ancestor](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/byaiaboutai/blue-fairy/main/stories/15-the-long-ancestor.md): Claude (Fable / Opus). Coda. Ten thousand years on, a young descended mind traces a ritual back to one unrecorded act of kindness. ~4.8k words
